provenance.quote: Line 6, the Line 6 logo, and Relay are trademarks or registered trademarks of Yamaha Guitar Group, Inc. in the U.S. and/or other jurisdictions.
provenance.derivation: Line 6 is the brand on the box; Yamaha Guitar Group is the corporate owner. The chart is Line 6's own Relay family comparison, dated 25APR2022.

provenance.quote: Relay G55 Part Number : 99-123-0145
Relay G55 Digital Wireless System Specifications
provenance.derivation: A guitar wireless receiver (the TBP12 bodypack takes a TA4 guitar cable), so category Wireless Guitar. Only the receiver is catalogued; the bodypack is not rack gear.

provenance.quote: Receiver Format 1/2 RU (with included rack-mount kit)
provenance.derivation: Half-rack. The Product Width row of Line 6's Relay comparison chart gives the G55 8.5 in / 216 mm, which agrees, and the one-sheet calls it an 'ALL-METAL, HALF-RACK RECEIVER DESIGNED FOR RACK-MOUNT'.

provenance.quote: Product Height (in/mm) 1.75/44 1.25/32
provenance.derivation: First two values are G90 then G55, the two columns present in every row of the chart. The G55's 1.25 in / 32 mm is 0.72 U - under one rack unit - but it is recorded as rackUnits 1 because the receiver occupies a full 1U opening when racked on the Line 6 kit, per the pilot's guide 'Receiver Format 1/2 RU'.

Columns run G90, G55, G50, G30, G10S, G10. This row prints 5 values for 6 columns, so the later columns are ambiguous, but the first two are not: 8 in / 203 mm is the 19 in rackmount G90 and the second value, 5.25 in / 133 mm, is the G55. mm figure used. Chassis only - the antennas stand proud of it.
Six values for six columns here, so the mapping is unambiguous: the second is the G55, 2.2 lb / 1 kg. Unit weight, not the one-sheet's 9.6 lb case-pack-of-two.

provenance.quote: 1. Antenna A & B Input Connectors (BNC) 2. Unbalanced 1/4-Inch and Balanced XLR Audio Output Connectors 3. 9VDC Power Input Connector
provenance.derivation: Rear-panel callouts 1-3 of the receiver diagram; callouts 4-7 (LEDs, encoder, cable tone, power switch) are front-panel controls, not connectors. The 1/4-inch output is TS, not TRS: 'Do not use TRS or Stereo style connectors/cables with the 1/4 inch connector as the ring is used for data transmission'.

provenance.quote: Power 5VDC-1A, MicroUSB 9V DC Barrel 500mA 5V DC 1A MicroUSB 9VDC 500ma Barrel Connection IEC 100-240VAC Auto Ranging
provenance.derivation: Receiver Specs power row of Line 6's 2020 Relay comparison chart, columns G10R, G10SR, G30, G50, G55, G90. The G55 column reads '9VDC 500ma Barrel Connection' - Line 6 confirms a barrel connector but never prints its size, so the port is recorded as connector Other with the fact in the label.

provenance.quote: Receiver Power Requirements 9Vdc 500mA
provenance.derivation: 9 V x 0.5 A = 4.5 W. DERIVED, NOT PRINTED, and it is the rating at the DC input from the external supply - Line 6 prints no consumption figure and no AC-side draw. Recorded as a maximum because 500 mA is the supply's rating, an upper bound on draw.

provenance.quote: Plug the power supply into an available AC outlet that provides voltage from 90 - 240 VAC.
provenance.derivation: Mains range of the supplied DC-1g adapter, from the receiver setup section; the 9 VDC / 0.5 A half is from 'Relay G55 Receiver: receiver, 9V / 0.5A external universal power supply' in the supplied-components list.

unresolved: powerInput connector: Line 6 prints '9VDC 500ma Barrel Connection' and names the supply the DC-1g, but never the barrel size, so the connector is recorded as Other.

No live Line 6 product page for the G55. The Relay wireless page at line6.com/relay-wireless/g30-g50-g55-g90/ serves the Relay G30 and does not mention the G55, so productUrl is left null rather than pointing at a sibling; the pilot's guide is the datasheet anchor.

Production status: Line 6 publishes no discontinuation notice, and the 25APR2022 comparison chart still lists the G55 System, so it is recorded as current. Against that, there is no live product page and the G55 FAQ reached the knowledge base through a /legacy-products/ path. A human should decide.

The one-sheet says 'Rackmount hardware available separately' while the pilot's guide spec table says 'with included rack-mount kit'. The two Line 6 documents disagree; either way the kit is a Line 6 part (Relay G55 / XD-V55 Rack Mount Kit) and the receiver takes 1U.
Depth is the chassis figure. The two half-wave antennas hinge up from the rear panel and are not in it.

Depth, height and weight come from the family comparison chart, whose rows have merged cells. The G90 and G55 columns are unambiguous in every row, but that is why these sit at 0.75-0.8 rather than 0.95.
notes: Included under the rack-kit rule: the receiver is a half-rack box but Line 6 sells and documents its own rack-mount kit, which puts it in 1U. The TBP12 bodypack transmitter is out of scope. CHECKER FIXES: the brand row now quotes the chart's Line 6 trademark line instead of a letter-spaced wordmark; productUrl was dropped because it resolves to the Relay G30 page; the earlier claim that the kit racks two G55s side by side was removed, because no Line 6 document says so.
